title: BAI Election Scheduled for December 26 in Guwahati
indian_angle: The upcoming election will determine the leadership of Indian badminton's governing body, directly impacting its future direction and policies.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced that its forthcoming election will take place on December 26, 2026, in Guwahati, Assam.

title: Eligibility List Released for 49th Junior National Badminton Championships
indian_angle: This list confirms the eligible players for one of India's most significant junior badminton tournaments, crucial for identifying future talent.
summary: The eligibility list for the Yonex-Sunrise 49th Junior National Badminton Championships, scheduled from November 14 to 21 in Sikkim, has been officially released.

title: Badminton Association of India Forms New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of this committee ensures greater player representation in decision-making processes within Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aiming to provide a direct voice for players in the sport's administration.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's top junior players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, a major international platform.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, focusing on intensive training for the Indian contingent.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: The camp at NCE Guwahati is crucial for honing the skills of India's promising U17 and U15 players ahead of the Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting a coaching camp for the Indian team preparing for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: Lakshya Sen Advances to Second Round at Kumamoto Masters Japan
indian_angle: India's top male shuttler Lakshya Sen securing a win in a Super 500 event is a positive start and boosts his ranking points.
summary: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen defeated Chinese Taipei’s Chi Yu Jen in straight games to progress to the second round of the Kumamoto Masters Japan.
